Head and gaze follow the already rotated chest naturally, not farther away as an isolated head turn. Keep her upright and balanced with no lateral leaning, no arching back, no twisting pelvis, no lifting feet, no pulling chair.
Camera and framing: camera straight ahead at seated chest height, portrait complete full body, shoulders pelvis knees and both whole feet visible, entire chair visible, head and shoes fully inside frame. Only one adult woman, normal real anatomical scale, clear chair and contact points.
Scene and style: exact original cool cloudy muted pale gray-blue photography studio backdrop from references, natural subtle cloudy mottling, seamless similar floor, soft neutral photographic illumination, realistic skin fabric and shadows.
Constraints: Anatomically correct two arms and two legs with natural hands. No shorts or cropped pants; full-length dark charcoal trousers. White flat athletic sneakers.
